title: Extract pure scene state projection from the frontend entrypoint
goal: Centralize scene display state and navigation transitions without moving business state or changing RPC behavior
acceptance: Scene projection is pure, immutable and has safe defaults
Overlay mode never exposes a drawer
Unknown navigation falls back to Chat instead of creating an uncontrolled page
main.js consumes the projection for shell rendering and navigation
No RPC, storage, provider, permission, portal or Avatar lifecycle behavior changes
escalate_when: Build or focused test failure repeats twice
